10 REM *********************
11 REM *     DRAW IMAGE    *
12 REM *********************
13 CLS
14 W=16
15 H=16
16 X=0
17 Y=0
18 T=0
19 M=(24576+(Y*32*8))+X
20 N=0
21 FOR I=0 TO 1748
22 READ J
23 IF J<0 THEN GOSUB 33:GOTO 28
24 POKE M+T,J
25 T=T+1
26 N=N+1
27 IF N=W THEN M=M+(32-W):N=0
28 NEXT I
29 END
30 REM *********************
31 REM *  DECOMPRESS IMAGE *
32 REM *********************
33 L=J
34 I=I+1
35 READ J
36 FOR K=L TO -1
37 POKE M+T,J
38 T=T+1
39 N=N+1
40 IF N=W THEN M=M+(32-W):N=0
41 NEXT K
42 RETURN
43 REM *********************
44 REM *     IMAGE CODE    *
45 REM *********************
